replacements.old: - Wrap user synchronization and unwanted-user cleanup in one outer `smbHelp.beginBatch()` / `endBatch()` transaction; the menu helper must not call `daemon-reload` directly.
replacements.new:
- Wrap desired-user synchronization in one outer `smbHelp.beginBatch()` / `endBatch()` transaction; the menu helper must not call `daemon-reload` directly. Destructive cleanup of users removed from the desired config runs only after that batch has physically finalized, because their complete local homes must be mount-free before the mandatory pre-delete backup is created.
- Destructive SFTP user removal must archive the complete local home after all managed mountpoints are detached and mountinfo confirms no live mount remains below the home. SysApps stores these root-only archives under `BACKUP_DIRECTORY/sftpusers/<user>/`; backup failure vetoes user deletion. The backup is a safety/forensic artifact, not an automatic restore source.
